customize.text:
<color=#ece5d8>Piramida, Nod-Krai</color>
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>The Spiralblade has been retrieved. You must return to Piramida without delay.</color>
Quest Objective: Head to Piramida
Quest Objective: Talk to the Lightkeeper
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ugh... This is crazy tense...
<color=#ffffff>Olav:</color> Illuga! Finally! Starshyna Nikita's been looking all over for you!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? Starshyna... Nikita?
Alternative Dialogue: If the player completed

customize.name: Tower of Inversion
customize.desc: You find a mysterious summons coming from the high tower…

customize.text:
first
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wait, Traveler, Nikita... isn't that the old guy we bumped into back in Piramida?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Didn't he say he was just a regular Ratnik?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Yeah...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: He didn't really seem like an ordinary Ratnik...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> Ah, my old pops... He probably just meant it as a bit of fun.
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> We can talk about that later. For now, let's go update him.
Quest Objective: Report to the old man
Optional Dialogue: Talk to Olav
<color=#ffffff>Olav:</color> Stop dallying. The Starshyna is waiting for you at the great mead hall.
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> Gramps, we're back!
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> Back safe, I see. How are things at Kipumaki Cliff?
<color=#ffffff>You give a quick rundown of what happened...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> Just as I thought... It's clear as day even from here. The Pillar of Embla has fallen to the Abyss... and that undying fiend they call the "Professor."
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> That said, it's been quiet for now. I can only assume Miss Alia is still fighting to keep it at bay.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> She's holding the line for us, and we must make the most of this window.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> Thanks to Flins and the others, preparations are nearly complete.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> And now that you've brought back the Spiralblade, the Arrow of Terpikeraunas is finally ready.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Umm... what's the "Arrow of Terpikeraunas"? Is it another super-powerful relic, like the Silver Lampwick and the Spiralblade?
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> Haha, it surpasses them both.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> Five centuries ago, the Torchforger lacked the strength to vanquish the undying fiend, managing only to seal it beneath Kipumaki Cliff. Even so, he did not waver. Together with the first Moonchanter, they pressed on in hope of a future victory.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> They forged this bow and arrow with ancient craft, so that when the day came to end the undying fiend, it would be ready. Since then, it has been passed down through generations of Lightkeepers.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> Now, at last, the time has come for it to fulfill its destiny.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Whoa... That sounds amazing! What does it look like? Can we see it?
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> You've seen it already, silly. In fact, we're inside it.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: What!?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Y—You're not about to fire us off with it or something... right? Right!?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Am I to be shot out along with the arrow?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> So Traveler really is our last-resort weapon! ... No, wait, that's gotta be a joke!
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> This great mead hall was built to house the Arrow of Terpikeraunas, and the Spiralblade you retrieved is the arrowhead it had long been missing.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> Once the Spiralblade is set in place, the Arrow will be ready to fire.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> This thing's a fireplace, though!
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> Indeed it is! But it also serves as the mechanism that shapes the Spiralblade into the arrowhead.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> We need to act before the Cataclysm Egg hatches. This bow and arrow have been passed down for this moment — to end the threat once and for all!
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> While you prepare the shot, that undying fiend will likely lash out one last time. Whatever comes our way, we'll stop it.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> The launching of the Arrow of Terpikeraunas is in your hands.
Quest Objective: Load the Spiralblade
Quest Objective: Go to the plaza
Optional Dialogue: Talk to Nikita
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> Go now. Get the sacred blade in place.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> Figures... That fiend's not going to give up without a fight.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> We'll keep the monsters at bay. Focus on finishing your mission.
Quest Objective: Activate the amplifier(s)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> The Abyssal creatures have made it this far...!
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> We can't afford to get bogged down here. Keep moving!
Quest Objective: Defeat the monsters
<color=#ffffff>Serpent of All Evils:</color> Sins... Unforgivable sins...
<color=#ffffff>Serpent of All Evils:</color> My fall... It's all your fault!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Paimon doesn't understand what's going on!
Quest Objective: Activate the amplifier(s)
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> The Buff Bestower's active! Just one more to go!
Quest Objective: Activate the remaining amplifier(s)
Quest Objective: Defeat the monsters
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> This insignificant world is but kindling for the blaze... A blaze no life will escape...
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> Save the loyal servants of our patron... Those fated to endure...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Why is it always this same weird nonsense nobody understands!?
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> It's getting away. Move — get after it!
Quest Objective: Activate the remaining amplifier(s)
Quest Objective: Go to the control room
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> Good! The control room's open!
Quest Objective: Destroy the Cataclysm Egg
<color=#ffffff>"The Professor":</color> The gate to the bedeviled sky is open, and still you cling to that puny pittance of kuuvahki as if it matters?
<color=#ffffff>"The Professor":</color> Yet... How am I still trapped here? Ah, I see... The Sampo Mill turns its face from me once more.
<color=#ffffff>Alia:</color> Well, well, look who finally showed up. What an honor.
<color=#ffffff>"The Professor":</color> ...Who's there?
<color=#ffffff>"The Professor":</color> This form... Relya? Ah, there you are. I knew you were still alive.
<color=#ffffff>"The Professor":</color> Now, bend the Sampo Mill's power to my will! You will succeed, with the sacred heir's blood burning inside you... Those other three were laughable failures, but not you, no. You've always been my chosen one.
<color=#ffffff>Alia:</color> Ha... He really thinks I'm Relya. So the mad monk who could once talk his way out of anything can't even see straight now. How ironic.
<color=#ffffff>"The Professor":</color> Relya, do not waver. You haven't forgotten our dream, have you? Don't you want to claim the name and the place that were always meant to be yours?
<color=#ffffff>"The Professor":</color> Picture it — an Elysium for the shamed and forgotten, a place where the proud fae nobles sink to their knees before you. And in this royal court of the Pale Star, only I, another human, can make that vision yours.
<color=#ffffff>"The Professor":</color> And now I stand just one step from the star-bound ascent... When the Elysium beyond the heavens unfolds upon this world, all others will be swept aside, leaving only us, the chosen few, to inherit what remains.
<color=#ffffff>"The Professor":</color> When that dawn comes, all the rot of this age will be washed away. Tell me, is that not the world you always hoped for?
<color=#ffffff>Alia:</color> No. That future was never his desire... And how could you still be peddling the same lie at a time like this?
<color=#ffffff>Alia:</color> You were using him from the very start. Every promise, every lie, you spun them all to make him seize the Sampo Mill for you. And that "Elysium" you keep preaching about? It was only ever meant for you.
<color=#ffffff>Alia:</color> Even his fall from rank, the path that turned him into a thief, that too was a trap you devised alongside Grand Duke Alvis. All of it.
<color=#ffffff>"The Professor":</color> ...
<color=#ffffff>Alia:</color> You might have called me Relya by mistake, but it suits me all the same. I carry his role and legacy, and the name Reed Miller is one I will take without hesitation.
<color=#ffffff>Alia:</color> Rauthvangi. Mad monk. "Professor." Undying serpent... Your story ends here. I will end it in Reed Miller's name.
Quest Objective: Talk to Illuga
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> We really did it...
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> That undying fiend is well and truly buried...
<color=#ffffff>Twice shall that undying serpent rise again, but thrice shall he be struck down... And at last shall he be laid to rest by the heroes of the sublunary sphere...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Standing alongside the courageous Ratniki, you defeat the "Professor" at long last...</color>
<color=#ffffff>For several days afterward, you stay in Piramida...</color>
Quest Objective: Go to the great mead hall
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>You have agreed to meet Illuga in the great mead hall...</color>
Quest Objective: Talk to Illuga
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Illuga's probably waiting in the great mead hall. Come on, Traveler, let's move!
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> Traveler, Paimon!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hehe, looks like we're right on time! This place is absolutely buzzin'!
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> Everyone's been hard at work these past few days. Now that things have finally settled down, we were able to find a moment to bring everyone together.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: It couldn't have been easy for you either.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> I only did what was expected of me. But... if you hadn't stepped in when you did, I imagine things might've ended very differently. We might've still won... but not without paying a steeper price.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Come on, we're in this together, aren't we? No need to be so serious!
<color=#ffffff>Illuga:</color> Yeah, you're right. Oh, looks like Gramps is about to speak.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> To all our comrades and kin — this isn't just a celebration. It's a moment to honor the struggle behind our triumph.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> Let us not forget, while we toast this victory, those who gave everything to make it possible. With their blood, they fulfilled the vow we all once made.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> During this battle, the "Nightmare Orioles" Investigation Squad, led by Illuga, took on what was perhaps the most perilous assignment of all.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> Notably, Traveler and his/her companion stepped forward without hesitation in a time of crisis and stood with us, playing a vital role in the operation's success.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> They braved every danger, pressed on through the storm, and carved a path to victory from the depths of despair.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> The legacy of their deeds, and of all who fought for the living and those yet to come, will be written into history, never to fade.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> Yes, we are victorious! That victory came at a heavy price, yes, and we may pause to mourn, to remember the fallen... but we must not be broken by grief.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> The future we fought for is within reach, and we carry the fire of those who lit the way before us. Their light must keep shining, and so we must press on.
<color=#ffffff>Nikita:</color> But today, let us raise our glasses: to victory, to the brave souls whose courage will never be forgotten, and to the future we vowed to protect.
